_notes.g.robots: No Disallow closes the whole site: the * group carries Allow: / and Googlebot's group an Allow, so the gate reads 5 although path rules close three checked pages. That is the case the access field exists for.
_notes._robots_paths: Checked: the eight sampled pages (the homepage among them) and the three sitemap URLs that are not among them, /blog/, the PDF and /about.html: 11. Under RFC 9309 Disallow: /pricing (8 characters) outweighs Allow: / and closes /pricing.html to the nine crawlers that read the * group, Disallow: /*.pdf$ closes the PDF to them, and Googlebot's Disallow: /docs/ closes /docs/setup.html. A first-match reading (urllib.robotparser) disagrees on three pages: it lets Allow: / open /pricing.html and the PDF, and lets Disallow: /docs/ close /docs/start.html, which Googlebot's longer Allow opens.
